request.style: English, female solo voice with warm choir, cello, piano, harp, flute, uplifting and reflective, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Consider it nothing but joy, my brothers
Whenever we fall into trials of every kind
You know the testing of your faith
Produces endurance in our daily life

[Chorus]
Nothing but joy, nothing but joy
Even when the trials come to find us
Nothing but joy, nothing but joy
Endurance grows and our spirits bind us

[Verse]
Let endurance finish its holy work
So that we may be mature and complete
Lacking nothing in this sacred path
Where our faith is tested and made sweet

[Chorus]
Nothing but joy, nothing but joy
Even when the trials come to find us
Nothing but joy, nothing but joy
Endurance grows and our spirits bind us

[Bridge]
If any of you lacks wisdom, ask God
He gives generously to all without fault
Ask in faith, without doubting or fear
Like a wave, do not let the wind halt

[Outro]
Mature and complete, lacking nothing
Nothing but joy, nothing but joy
